== Biography ==
Helen was born about 1837 in Airdrie, Lanarkshire, Scotland.  She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-424|John Glasgow]] and [[Forsyth-878|Christina Forsyth]]. <ref name = 1851C/>

In 1841 Helen was living in Arden, Clarkston with her parents and her sister<ref>(Scotland Census 1841:Parish:Clarkston; ED:6b; Page;16; Line:1370; Year:1841)</ref>

In 1851 Helen was living at 37 Aitchison Street New Monkland with her parents, siblings and granny  <ref name = 1851C>
